title.zh: Renzo回应MetaMask安全事件：Basis风险与流动性可完全链上验证，目前提现队列中仅有214.75枚stETH
title.en: Renzo回应MetaMask安全事件：Basis风险与流动性可完全链上验证，目前提现队列中仅有214.75枚stETH

current_state.zh: MetaMask因非托管质押安全事件退出17,000个验证者，涉及超523,000枚stETH（约14亿美元），其中18个验证者的奖励被转至Tornado Cash资助地址；Renzo此前表示其Basis/ezETH未受影响，提现队列仅214.75枚stETH。
current_state.en: MetaMask is exiting 17,000 validators tied to its non-custodial staking security incident, covering over 523,000 stETH (~$1.4 billion), after rewards from 18 validators were diverted to a Tornado Cash-funded address; Renzo previously said its Basis/ezETH were unaffected with only 214.75 stETH in its withdrawal queue.

updates.what_changed_zh: Renzo 表示其 Basis 产品和 ezETH 未受 MetaMask 基础设施安全事件影响，提款队列中仅有 214.75 stETH（0.5%），MetaMask 正主动将受影响的验证者从其非托管质押服务中退出。
updates.what_changed_en: Renzo said its Basis product and ezETH remain unaffected by the MetaMask infrastructure security incident, with just 214.75 stETH (0.5%) in its withdrawal queue, as MetaMask proactively exits impacted validators from its non-custodial staking service.

updates.title_zh: MetaMask 在验证者奖励被盗后解除 14 亿美元 ETH 质押
updates.title_en: MetaMask unstakes $1.4B of ETH after validator rewards stolen
updates.what_changed_zh: MetaMask已主动启动17,000个以太坊验证者退出，涉及超过523,000枚质押ETH（约14亿美元）；此前18个验证者的区块奖励被转移至一个由Tornado Cash资助的地址。
updates.what_changed_en: MetaMask proactively initiated the exit of 17,000 Ethereum validators holding over 523,000 staked ETH (~$1.4 billion), after block rewards from 18 validators were diverted to a Tornado Cash-funded address.
updates.current_state_zh: MetaMask因非托管质押安全事件退出17,000个验证者，涉及超523,000枚stETH（约14亿美元），其中18个验证者的奖励被转至Tornado Cash资助地址；Renzo此前表示其Basis/ezETH未受影响，提现队列仅214.75枚stETH。
updates.current_state_en: MetaMask is exiting 17,000 validators tied to its non-custodial staking security incident, covering over 523,000 stETH (~$1.4 billion), after rewards from 18 validators were diverted to a Tornado Cash-funded address; Renzo previously said its Basis/ezETH were unaffected with only 214.75 stETH in its withdrawal queue.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: MetaMask proactively initiated the exit of 17,000 Ethereum validators holding over 523,000 staked ETH ($1.4 billion) after block rewards from 18 validators were found diverted to a Tornado Cash-funded address in a staking-security incident.
updates.detailed_summary_en: MetaMask proactively initiated the exit of 17,000 Ethereum validators holding over 523,000 staked ETH ($1.4 billion) after block rewards from 18 validators were found diverted to a Tornado Cash-funded address in a staking-security incident.
